summary: Adds an "Update Tools from Library" Job context-menu command and load-time prompt (gated by a new CAM > Assets preference) that fully replaces stale embedded ToolBits from the library, and extends the Feeds & Speeds Presets tab with a Notes field, required unique names, sortable columns and a Copy button.
